mail_path.description: The root directory of the Maildir structure where mail folders are stored.

mblaze_dir.description: The directory where mblaze stores user state, such as saved sequences and the current message symlink.

editor.description: The text editor command used by mcom to compose messages.

pager.description: The pager command used to display message content in interactive tools like mless.

sort_key.description: The default field to sort messages by in mlist/msort (e.g., date, from, subject, size).

sort_dir.description: The default sort order direction (asc or desc) for mlist/msort.

mailer.description: The external command used to send outgoing messages.
